The article suggests strategies like investing in U.S. bonds, non-U.S. equities, equal-weighted S&P 500 strategies, and alternative assets to mitigate this risk.

title: Should iShares Russell 1000 ETF (IWB) Be on Your Investing Radar?
summary: The iShares Russell 1000 ETF (IWB) offers broad exposure to the Large Cap Blend segment of the US equity market, with over $34.55 billion in assets and a low expense ratio of 0.15%. Featuring top holdings like Microsoft, Apple, and Nvidia, the ETF has performed well, returning 7.02% year-to-date and 27.20% over the last year. It holds a Zacks ETF Rank of 3 (Hold) and is considered a good option for investors seeking exposure to large-cap blend stocks, with alternatives like IVV and SPY also available.

title: WhatsApp to Allow Cross-Functional Chatting Soon
summary: WhatsApp is preparing to introduce cross-platform interoperability, allowing its users to chat with contacts on other messaging apps without leaving WhatsApp. This significant policy shift is influenced by the EU’s Digital Markets Act, which designated Meta as a "gatekeeper" and requires the company to open its messaging services. The feature, initially limited to one-on-one messaging, aims to enhance user convenience but presents complex security challenges due to differing encryption standards across platforms.

title: SCHX: As Cheap As It Gets For Large-Cap Exposure
summary: This article recommends the Schwab U.S. Large-Cap ETF (SCHX) for investors seeking exposure to large-cap stocks, highlighting its diversification, low costs, and tax efficiency. Key holdings include tech giants like Microsoft and Apple, leading to significant exposure to the Information Technology sector. The author, Michael A. Gayed, CFA, discusses market efficiency and offers insights from his Lead-Lag Report service.

title: Fortune 500 list: The top 10 companies dominating business
summary: This article details the top 10 companies on the 2023 Fortune 500 list, ranked by revenue, ahead of the 2024 list release. Walmart maintains the top spot for the eleventh consecutive year, followed by Amazon, Exxon Mobil, and Apple. The report provides key financial figures, strategic moves, and recent developments for each company, highlighting their influence on the global economy.

title: TSMC to Win More Than $5 Billion in Grants for US Chip Plant
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) is expected to receive over $5 billion in federal grants for its chipmaking project in Arizona, a significant move for President Biden's bid to revitalize American semiconductor manufacturing. This award, part of the 2022 Chips and Science Act, is not yet finalized but marks a major step in distributing funds to leading chipmakers like Intel, Micron Technology, and Samsung. TSMC is investing $40 billion in two Arizona fabrication facilities, though the project has faced delays due to labor shortages and technological considerations.

title: Alphabet is the bargain stock among the ‘Magnificent Seven’
summary: Alphabet, Google's holding company, is highlighted as a compelling investment opportunity among the "Magnificent Seven" tech stocks due to its valuation. Its stock trades at a lower price/earnings valuation than the S&P 500, positioning it as a bargain compared to its peers and the broader market. This situation is likened to the opportunity presented by Meta's stock after its 2022 decline.

title: COPP Stock Price | Sprott Copper Miners ETF
summary: This article provides an in-depth look at the Sprott Copper Miners ETF (COPP), including its current stock price, trading exchange, and key financial statistics like expense ratio, dividends, and asset composition. It also features a company profile, performance data, and holdings information, alongside technical analysis and recent news related to copper prices. The ETF invests in public equity markets within the materials, metals, mining, and copper sectors.

title: Apple v. Rivos: Lessons for Companies Facing Claims of Trade Secret Theft (US)
summary: This article discusses the lessons learned from the Apple v. Rivos case regarding trade secret theft. It highlights that mere possession of trade secrets is insufficient for misappropriation claims against a new employer and emphasizes the importance of explicit policies against bringing confidential information from former employers. The ruling provides key takeaways for companies to guide their trade secret policies and practices to avoid litigation.

title: 3 Stocks to Buy Before the Fintech Sector Starts to Sizzle Again
summary: The fintech sector, though currently lukewarm compared to other tech areas, is poised for a rebound as the economic landscape improves. SoFi Technologies (SOFI) is navigating a capital raise but remains a key beneficiary of potential Fed rate cuts, while Block (SQ) is showing signs of recovery, boosted by renewed consumer spending and crypto enthusiasm. Apple (AAPL), despite its focus on AI and new devices, has a significant and growing fintech services business that could drive future earnings.

title: Inverse/Leveraged Magnificent Seven ETFs Hit the Market
summary: Roundhill Investments has launched two new ETFs focusing on the "Magnificent Seven" tech stocks: the Roundhill Daily 2X Long Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGX) and the Roundhill Daily Inverse Magnificent Seven ETF (MAGQ). MAGX offers 2x leveraged daily exposure to the Magnificent Seven, while MAGQ provides inverse (-1X) daily exposure. These funds cater to investors looking to capitalize on both potential gains and losses of these influential tech giants, which significantly impact the S&P 500 and are highly valued, indicating a need for both bullish and bearish investment options.

title: The Apple Effect: Magic Leap Founder’s Previous Company Launches App on Vision Pro
summary: Stryker's Mako, a robotic surgery group initially founded by Magic Leap's founder Rony Abovitz, has launched its myMako app on Apple Vision Pro. This move highlights "The Apple Effect" where Apple's market influence draws companies into specific product categories. The article compares Vision Pro's appeal to Magic Leap's earlier struggles and notes how Apple's stability and ecosystem are encouraging XR-adjacent companies to adopt its platform.

title: Forget Warren Buffett Stocks. Check Out What Todd Boehly Is Up to With RDE, Inc. [OTC: RSTN] Instead
summary: This article suggests investors look beyond Warren Buffett's 13F filings to Todd Boehly's activities, specifically his 11.8% stake in RDE, Inc. [OTC: RSTN]. It highlights Boehly's track record of successful investments through Eldridge Industries and his involvement with Vivid Seats' acquisition of Vegas.com, which saw a 6x valuation boost for Vegas.com. The author posits that a similar significant increase in value could be on the horizon for RDE, Inc., which operates Restaurant.com and CardCash.com.

title: Will Warren Buffett Keep Selling Apple?
summary: Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway recently reduced its stake in Apple, leading to speculation about whether further sales will occur. This article explores Buffett's history with Apple, current challenges facing the tech giant such as declining sales in China and competitive pressures, and the potential market reaction to Berkshire's next 13F filing. Analysts offer differing views on Apple's future, particularly with the upcoming integration of AI.

title: Sonos Era 100 review: Room-filling sound meets thoughtful improvements
summary: The Sonos Era 100 is a revamped smart speaker offering significant improvements over its predecessors like the Sonos One. It provides impressive, room-filling sound quality with enhanced stereo separation and a larger woofer. Notable new features include Bluetooth support and a USB-C port for line-in audio, making it versatile despite lacking Google Assistant and certain Trueplay advanced tuning for Android users.

title: Apple’s Restore Fund cultivates new roots in the Atlantic Forest
summary: Apple's Restore Fund is supporting reforestation efforts in South America's Atlantic Forest through two key projects: Symbiosis in Brazil and Forestal Apepu in Paraguay. Symbiosis focuses on planting biodiverse native species using seeds from "mother trees" and employing technology to monitor carbon sequestration, while Forestal Apepu cultivates fast-growing eucalyptus for timber while also implementing social impact initiatives to support local communities. Both projects aim to restore the rainforest, enhance biodiversity, and provide sustainable livelihoods, demonstrating a "symbiotic" approach to environmental and community well-being.

title: LaCie Introduces New Rugged Mini SSD with Up to 4TB Capacity
summary: LaCie, a brand of Seagate, has introduced the new Rugged Mini SSD, offering up to 4TB of durable, fast, and compact storage for content creators. This portable drive boasts read speeds of up to 2000MB/s with USB 3.2 gen 2x2 technology and features an IP54-rated, 3-meter drop-protected, and 1-ton car pressure-resistant design using recycled materials. It is compatible with a wide range of devices including Apple products and PCs, and comes with a three-year warranty, data recovery services, and a one-month Adobe Creative Cloud All Apps plan.

title: Markets Showing Signs of Bubble on Big Tech, Crypto Surge, BofA’s Hartnett Says
summary: Bank of America’s Chief Investment Strategist Michael Hartnett believes that the current market surge in "Magnificent Seven" tech stocks and cryptocurrencies exhibits characteristics of a bubble. He points to re-accelerating inflation, soft growth, and the narrowness of gaining assets as signs of a "bubble mentality."

title: Allstate Protection Plans Finds 78 Million Americans Damaged Their Smartphones in the Last Year. The Nation's Repair and Replacement Bill Now Totals $149 Billion Since the Introduction of the Smartphone
summary: A new study by Allstate Protection Plans reveals that 78 million Americans damaged their smartphones in the past year, contributing to a total repair and replacement bill of $149 billion since smartphones were introduced. The research highlights increased smartphone usage, a surge in screen repair costs to $8.3 billion in 2023, and growing consumer concern for the environmental impact of device replacements. It also notes common types of damage, the short time consumers wait for repairs, and factors influencing smartphone purchase decisions related to sustainability.

title: Watch BofA’s Hartnett Sees Characteristics of a Bubble in Mag 7, Crypto
summary: Bank of America Corp.'s Chief Investment Strategist, Michael Hartnett, believes that the record-setting performance of the "Magnificent Seven" tech stocks and the all-time highs in cryptocurrencies exhibit characteristics of a bubble. He shared these insights during a discussion with Bloomberg's Francine Lacqua at the Bank of America Global Investor Summit conference in Rome. The article highlights his assessment of current market conditions.

title: VGT ETF: High Growth, High Concentration (NYSEARCA:VGT)
summary: Vanguard's Information Technology ETF (VGT) has demonstrated strong historical returns, achieving a 48.3% return over the past year and an average annual return of 20% over the last decade. However, the fund is highly concentrated, with Microsoft and Apple accounting for nearly 41% of its investments. VGT offers a low dividend yield of 0.6%, making it less appealing for investors prioritizing income.

title: Apple Highlights Stryker, an NJIT Alum's Medical Tech Group, for VisionPro App
summary: Apple has recognized Stryker Corp., a medical technology company led by NJIT alumnus Robert Cohen, for its innovative MyMako app utilizing the new VisionPro mixed-reality headset. This app allows surgeons to plan and simulate robot-assisted knee replacement operations in 3D, enhancing surgical planning, in-operation information access, and resident training. Cohen envisions future integration of AI to further optimize implant selection and placement based on patient data within this mixed-reality framework.

title: Gaia Launches Gaia+, the World’s Most Extensive Streaming Platform for Transformation
summary: Gaia, Inc. has launched Gaia+, an enhanced streaming platform offering over 8,000 documentaries and series focused on transformation, spiritual growth, and consciousness expansion. This new platform provides access to immersive workshops, live events, and guided programs led by expert teachers. Gaia+ aims to empower its community with resources for personal development, stress alleviation, and abundance manifestation, available across various mobile and connected TV devices.

title: Options Bulls Resume Blitz on Alphabet Stock
summary: Alphabet (GOOGL) stock is seeing renewed bullish options activity, with shares up 6.1% following reports of Apple potentially licensing Google's Gemini AI. Despite a recent uptick in bearish bets, call volume is again dominating today's options trading as GOOGL eyes its Jan. 29 record high.

title: BofA Survey Shows Risk-On Rotation Out of US Tech Into European Stocks
summary: A recent Bank of America fund manager survey indicates a "risk-on" shift among investors, with increased allocations to European and emerging market stocks. This rotation comes at the expense of US equities, particularly the technology and consumer discretionary sectors. Financials also saw favor in the March survey, signaling a broader move away from concentrated US tech investments.

title: Apple Inc. stock outperforms competitors on strong trading day
summary: Apple Inc. stock (AAPL) climbed 1.36% to $176.08 on a strong trading day, outpacing the broader market indices like the NASDAQ Composite and the Dow Jones Industrial Average. This marks the second consecutive day of gains for Apple's shares.

title: Meta Bows Down to EU Regulations After Apple And Google, Cut Subscription Prices for Ad-Free Facebook and Instagram
summary: Meta Platforms has significantly reduced the subscription fee for its ad-free Facebook and Instagram services in Europe, lowering the monthly cost to 5.99 euros from 9.99 euros. This move addresses concerns from privacy and antitrust regulators and comes as a response to the EU's Digital Markets Act (DMA). The company aims to find a middle ground amidst EU privacy laws and the DMA's stipulations, following similar concessions by Google and Apple.

title: CONY Total Assets Under Management Insights
summary: This article provides insights into the Total Assets Under Management (AUM) for the YieldMax COIN Option Income Strategy ETF (CONY), which currently stands at $420.46 million as of May 19, 2026. title: Meta, Microsoft, X and Match join Epic Games' battle against Apple
summary: Meta Platforms, Microsoft, X, and Match Group have joined Epic Games in accusing Apple of violating a court-ordered injunction regarding payments in its App Store. The companies claim Apple is in "clear violation" by making it difficult for developers to direct consumers to alternative, cheaper payment methods for digital content. Apple, however, maintains it has fully complied with the injunction, arguing it protects consumers and its ecosystem.

title: Impact Shares YWCA Women’s Empowerment ETF (WOMN) Reaches $50M in Assets Under Management
summary: The Impact Shares YWCA Women’s Empowerment ETF ($WOMN) has surpassed $50 million in Assets Under Management (AUM), demonstrating investor interest in socially conscious funds. This ETF provides broad market exposure to U.S. companies promoting gender equity, with all net advisory profits donated to the YWCA to support its mission. The partnership between Impact Shares, Tidal Financial Group, and the YWCA highlights an innovative approach to aligning financial returns with social impact.

title: The U.S. sues Apple, saying it abuses its power to monopolize the smartphone market
summary: The Justice Department, along with 15 states and D.C., has filed a major antitrust lawsuit against Apple, accusing the tech giant of abusing its monopoly power in the smartphone market. The lawsuit alleges that Apple restricts access to its hardware and software, designs features like iMessage and Apple Pay to lock users into its ecosystem, and suppresses competition, leading to fewer options and higher prices for consumers. Apple denies these claims, stating that its restrictions protect user privacy and security, and vows to vigorously defend itself against the suit.

title: Apple Loses $113 Billion in Value After Regulators Close In
summary: Apple Inc. is facing regulatory scrutiny on both sides of the Atlantic, causing its market value to drop by $113 billion. The U.S. Justice Department has filed an antitrust lawsuit against the iPhone maker, while European regulators are investigating its compliance with the Digital Markets Act. These actions are raising investor concerns about potential fines and the company's market dominance.

title: DOJ faces tough road in Apple antitrust lawsuit
summary: The Department of Justice's antitrust lawsuit against Apple faces significant challenges, despite drawing parallels to the successful Microsoft case two decades ago. Antitrust specialists highlight key differences and legal precedents that could make it difficult for the DOJ to prove Apple's monopolistic conduct and force product redesigns. Apple is expected to argue that its "walled-garden" approach benefits consumers and that the government's market definition is flawed.

title: Get to know QQQ: Charting 25 years of performance
summary: The article celebrates 25 years of the Invesco QQQ ETF, tracing its evolution from its launch in 1999 to becoming one of the largest ETFs today. summary: The iShares Morningstar Growth ETF (ILCG) is highlighted as a strong option for investors seeking growth, offering diversified exposure to 389 top U.S. large- and mid-cap growth stocks. Despite slightly underperforming the S&P 500 over three years, ILCG has outperformed it over five and ten-year periods, making it a reliable, cost-effective long-term investment.

title: Under Pressure: Antitrust and Competition Authorities are Now Focusing on Apple
summary: Antitrust and competition authorities in both the EU and the US are increasingly scrutinizing Apple's market practices, a significant shift for a company that previously avoided intense regulatory attention. Recent actions include a substantial fine from the European Commission related to App Store policies and a lawsuit from the US Department of Justice alleging anticompetitive practices designed to maintain iPhone user lock-in. These developments suggest a global movement towards stricter regulation of big tech, challenging Apple's long-held justifications of privacy and security for its closed ecosystem.

title: Masimo plans to spin off consumer business
summary: Medical technology company Masimo Corp is evaluating a proposed spinoff of its consumer business, which includes consumer health and audio products. Masimo's shares rose 13% on the news, which follows investor pressure for changes after a poorly received acquisition. The company plans to retain its healthcare and telehealth products, expecting improved profitability, and current CEO Joe Kiani will lead the new spun-off company as chairman.

title: Explainer: US lawsuit against Apple could make iPhone experience more consumer-friendly
summary: The U.S. Justice Department has filed a lawsuit against Apple, aiming to increase competition for the iPhone and benefit smaller companies developing apps for the device. The lawsuit claims Apple has harmed smaller rivals and inflated prices. If successful, it could lead to changes in the U.S. similar to those already implemented in Europe, such as universal charging cables, alternative app stores, and broader browser choices.

title: Wait, Did Europe Really Outperform the U.S. over the Last Three Years?
summary: This article challenges the common perception that European equities perpetually lag behind their U.S. counterparts. title: Apple’s stock has faltered, but a Steve Jobs moment in AI may be on the horizon
summary: Apple's stock performance has been underwhelming, leading to concerns about its AI capabilities. However, an analyst suggests that Apple CEO Tim Cook might be preparing a "Steve Jobs moment" by announcing an AI app store, similar to how Wall Street initially underestimated the iTunes Store. This could represent a significant play in the artificial intelligence sector, despite previous doubts fueled by reports of Apple discussing AI engines with other tech giants.

title: Baidu Shares Rise After Reports That Apple Will Use Its AI Services in China Products
summary: Baidu's shares increased significantly in Hong Kong following reports that Apple plans to utilize Baidu's AI services for its products in China. The collaboration, which has been the subject of preliminary talks, would make Baidu Apple's local generative AI model provider for the iPhone 16, Mac operating system, and iOS 18. This partnership is pending approval from Chinese regulators for generative AI models.

title: 7 Best Brand Video Marketing Campaigns
summary: This article highlights seven effective brand video marketing campaigns, emphasizing the power of digital video to engage and convert audiences. It showcases diverse examples from Starbucks, Samsung, Mattress Firm, Honda, Toggl, Amazon Books, and Liebherr Home Appliances, detailing their creative strategies, execution, and impressive results. The campaigns demonstrate how innovative storytelling and strategic platform use can significantly boost brand visibility, engagement, and sales.

title: More Canadians ditch traditional TV as streamers are ‘winning the battle’: report
summary: A new report indicates a significant shift in Canadian television viewing habits towards streaming platforms and away from traditional cable and satellite. By the end of 2023, 42% of Canadian households had no traditional TV subscription, a figure expected to reach 50% by 2026. Conversely, over 80% of households subscribe to a streaming service, with streaming revenue increasing while traditional TV revenue declined, prompting calls for regulatory changes from Canadian broadcasters to level the playing field.

title: FTEC: Concentration Increases Volatility (NYSEARCA:FTEC)
summary: The Fidelity MSCI Information Technology Index ETF (FTEC) offers strong tech exposure, performing similarly to VGT. summary: Zacks Small Cap Research initiated coverage on ATRenew Inc. (NYSE: RERE) with a 12-month price target of $4.00, citing its leadership in China's pre-owned consumer electronics market. title: One Fifth of Applied Materials Shareholders Vote to Address the Pay Gap
summary: Just over 20% of Applied Materials (AMAT) shareholders voted for a proposal requesting the company report on pay gaps across race and gender. This level of support, while lower than similar proposals at other tech giants, still sends a message to the board about the importance of the issue. The article also touches on other significant proxy season themes, including unionization, simple majority voting, climate change, corporate political influence, and artificial intelligence.

ETF analyst Todd Sohn from Strategas Securities notes that this product appears to be the most heavily levered available in any developed market.

summary: The SEC has sided with Alliance Defending Freedom attorneys in two recent decisions, denying attempts by Wells Fargo and Charles Schwab to exclude shareholder proposals from their proxy ballots. This marks ADF's fifth such victory, compelling financial giants to address concerns regarding politicized de-banking and workforce discrimination rooted in DEI policies. The rulings emphasize shareholder accountability and transparency in corporate decision-making.

title: Executive Turntable: Sphere Gets Creative; PushaRod Joins Hallwood; Wasserman Orchestrates Division
summary: This article details recent executive appointments and promotions within the music industry. summary: This article provides an in-depth analysis of the STF Tactical Growth ETF (TUG), detailing its management style, investment strategy, key statistics like AUM and expense ratio, and recent performance. summary: PDD Holdings, the company behind Pinduoduo and Temu, has attracted investor attention despite a recent 17% decline in its Nasdaq-listed shares, with analysts overwhelmingly bullish. Investors are advised to weigh these risks against potential rewards for informed decision-making.

title: EQT Corp. (EQT) to Acquire Avetta from WCAS
summary: EQT Private Equity's EQT X fund has agreed to acquire Avetta, a global leader in supply chain risk management software, from Welsh, Carson, Anderson & Stowe (WCAS). EQT plans to support Avetta's continued growth through product innovation, AI adoption, and global expansion. The transaction is subject to regulatory approvals and financial terms were not disclosed.

title: F5 Networks (FFIV) Appoints Kunal Anand as Chief Technology Officer
summary: F5, Inc. announced the appointment of Kunal Anand as Executive Vice President and Chief Technology Officer (CTO), alongside Lyra Schramm as Executive Vice President and Chief People Officer (CPO). Anand will be responsible for F5's technology vision, leveraging his expertise in cybersecurity and data to accelerate the company's leadership in application and API security. Schramm will focus on driving people initiatives and fostering an innovative workplace culture.

title: Xiaomi Unveils Revolutionary SU7 Electric Vehicle Equipped with Hesai High-Performance Lidar
summary: Xiaomi has launched its first mass-produced electric vehicle, the SU7, featuring Hesai's high-performance AT128 long-range lidar in its Pro and Max versions. The SU7 garnered over 88,898 reservations on its first day and integrates a unique "pebble" aesthetic with a "watchtower style" lidar placement designed for optimal aerodynamics. This collaboration highlights Xiaomi's full-stack self-developed intelligent driving technology, enhanced by Hesai's advanced lidar for improved perception and a safer driving experience.

title: FemTech and the Gender Health Gap
summary: A report by Citi Global Insights highlights the gender health gap, noting that women experience poorer health outcomes and negative healthcare experiences compared to men. FemTech, which uses digital technology to address women's health conditions, is presented as a crucial tool for closing this gap, despite being a smaller sector within healthcare innovation. The article also points out systemic issues like underfunded research and weak financial incentives that have historically disadvantaged women's health.

title: Target shopper data, streaming TV ads are key to its sales
summary: Target is increasingly relying on its retail media unit, Roundel, which creates and sells ads using shopper data and streaming TV ads, to drive revenue and improve gross margins. Despite declining merchandise sales, Target's ad business grew over 20% in its last fiscal year, leveraging insights from 250 million annual store and website visits to target specific shoppers for brands like Enfamil and Apple. While the ad business provides significant value, some advertisers note that Roundel offers less control over campaigns compared to rivals like Amazon and Walmart.

title: Leading chipmaker TSMC evacuates staff and pauses some machinery after Taiwan's largest earthquake in a quarter-century
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC), the world's largest advanced chipmaker, and its rival United Microelectronics Corp. (UMC) halted some machinery and evacuated staff after Taiwan experienced its strongest earthquake in 25 years. The 7.4 magnitude temblor raised concerns about the semiconductor supply chain's vulnerability, given Taiwan's critical role in producing high-end chips. TSMC shares slid about 1.5% and UMC less than 1% in early trading following the event.

title: Spotify to raise prices of plans in some markets, Bloomberg News reports
summary: Spotify is reportedly planning to increase its subscription prices by $1 to $2 per month in several markets, including the UK, Australia, and Pakistan, by the end of April. Prices in the United States are expected to rise later in the year, alongside the introduction of a new basic tier offering music and podcasts but no audiobooks. This move aims to boost profitability for the company, which forecasts strong subscriber growth and is diversifying its offerings beyond music.

title: Cashing in on the Bitcoin Bounce: 3 Stocks to Buy for Indirect Crypto Exposure
summary: The article identifies three stocks—MercadoLibre (MELI), Broadcom (AVGO), and SBI Holdings Inc (SBHGF)—that offer investors indirect exposure to the cryptocurrency market. These companies are involved in various blockchain-related activities, such as crypto trading, integration of blockchain technology, and investments in crypto startups, providing an alternative for those hesitant about direct crypto investments. The author suggests these stocks allow investors to benefit from Bitcoin's performance while diversifying their portfolios and maintaining traditional stock stability.

title: Garmin Lily 2 Review: A Smartwatch That Doesn't Scream 'Fitness Tracker'
summary: The Garmin Lily 2 is presented as a fashion-forward smartwatch for women, offering sleek design and robust health tracking features like body battery and stress scores. The author also notes the subtle differences and near-identical returns between VV and the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF, with a slight preference for VV.

title: EU regulators assess Apple's plan for complying with music streaming order
summary: EU antitrust regulators are evaluating Apple's proposal to comply with an order requiring it to allow music streaming services like Spotify to inform users of alternative payment options outside its App Store. Apple faces potential antitrust charges and additional fines if its proposed solution, which includes a 27% fee on digital purchases made via external links, does not satisfy the European Commission. The Commission is also investigating Apple's App Store rules under the new Digital Markets Act.

title: TSMC Arizona and U.S. Department of Commerce Announce up to US$6.6 Billion in Proposed CHIPS Act Direct Funding, the Company Plans Third Leading-Edge Fab in Phoenix
summary: TSMC Arizona and the U.S. Department of Commerce have signed a preliminary memorandum for up to US$6.6 billion in CHIPS Act direct funding. TSMC plans to build a third advanced semiconductor fab in Phoenix, Arizona, bringing its total investment in the site to over US$65 billion. This expansion aims to enhance U.S. semiconductor manufacturing capabilities and create thousands of high-tech jobs, with production from the three fabs utilizing 4nm, 2nm, and more advanced processes.

title: Apple Signs Deal For AI Training Data from Image Service Shutterstock
summary: Apple has signed a deal worth between $25 million and $50 million with Shutterstock to access its vast archive of images, video, and music for training AI systems. This move indicates Apple's strategic intent to develop its own AI models, rather than relying solely on existing solutions. The deal highlights Apple's characteristic approach to adhere to rules and protect user privacy, contrasting with some competitors' controversial methods of data acquisition.

summary: The Fidelity Hedged Equity ETF (FHEQ), established on April 9, 2024, is an actively managed ETF focusing on large-cap equity. It holds 159 stocks, with a total of $865.43 million in assets under management. The fund aims for capital appreciation through quantitative analysis and uses put options for downside protection.

title: Better Chip Stock: Marvell Technology vs. Qualcomm
summary: This article compares Marvell Technology (MRVL) and Qualcomm (QCOM) as semiconductor stock investments. Marvell, despite a near-term slowdown, is driven by AI-oriented chips and acquisitions, while Qualcomm is recovering from a smartphone market downturn with diversification into automotive and IoT, alongside new AI mobile chips. The author concludes that Qualcomm is the better buy due to its lower valuation, higher dividend yield, and anticipated market recovery.

title: Apple's New Jersey store workers file petition for unionization
summary: Workers at an Apple store in Short Hills, New Jersey, have filed for union representation with the Communications Workers of America. This move is part of a broader unionization push across various companies in corporate America, including Starbucks, Amazon.com, and Microsoft, where employees are seeking better working conditions. title: Why Ticketmaster Owner Live Nation's Shares Are Tumbling Today
summary: Live Nation Entertainment (LYV) shares are falling after the U.S. Department of Justice and several states prepared to file an antitrust lawsuit against the company. The lawsuit, expected to be filed in New York, targets Live Nation's control over concert ticket sales and could potentially lead to the company's breakup. This legal action is part of the Biden administration's effort to combat monopolistic practices, fueled by past violations and public scrutiny following Ticketmaster's handling of Taylor Swift concert tickets.

title: Live Nation Entertainment Stock Tumbles as DOJ Announces Antitrust Suit

The DOJ seeks to break up the company, causing Live Nation's stock to tumble 8% following the announcement. Live Nation denies the claims, arguing its profitability is low and its commission rates are competitive.

title: U.S., states including Ohio sue to break up Live Nation, Ticketmaster over practices
summary: The U.S. Justice Department and nearly 30 states, including Ohio, have filed a lawsuit against Live Nation Entertainment Inc. to compel the company to divest its ticketing giant, Ticketmaster. The plaintiffs allege that Live Nation and Ticketmaster have illegally monopolized the live events industry through anticompetitive practices, such as locking venues into exclusive contracts and retaliating against rivals. Live Nation stated it would defend itself, claiming the lawsuit would not resolve fan issues regarding ticket prices and fees.

title: JAVS Courtroom Recording Software Backdoored - Deploys RustDoor Malware
summary: Malicious actors have backdoored the installer for Justice AV Solutions (JAVS) courtroom video recording software to distribute malware known as RustDoor, a supply chain attack tracked as CVE-2024-4978. The compromised installer, JAVS Viewer v8.3.7, was signed with an unexpected Authenticode signature, leading to the deployment of a malicious executable that contacts a command-and-control server and attempts to gather credentials. JAVS has acknowledged a "potential security issue," pulled the affected version, and advised users to check for indicators of compromise and re-image affected systems.

Jabil Inc. will invest ₹2,000 crore in an electronics manufacturing unit in Tiruchi, creating 5,000 jobs, while Rockwell Automation will expand its unit in Kancheepuram with an investment of ₹666 crore. These investments were formalized through MoUs signed in the presence of Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin in Chicago.

title: JABIL to invest ₹2,000 crore in electronics manufacturing facility at Manapparai, create 5,000 Jobs
summary: JABIL, a $35 billion global manufacturing company, will invest ₹2,000 crore to establish an electronics manufacturing facility in Manapparai, Tamil Nadu, creating over 5,000 jobs. This investment, formalized through an MoU exchanged in the US, marks the emergence of Tamil Nadu's third major electronics cluster in Trichy and is expected to significantly boost the central zone's economy. Additionally, Rockwell Automation is expanding its manufacturing with a ₹666 crore investment in Kanchipuram, and an MoU was signed with Autodesk for skill development.

title: Ireland’s special relationship with Apple and Google has created a multibillion-dollar windfall—and an existential crisis
summary: Ireland recently received a €13 billion tax windfall from Apple, resulting from an EU ruling on unpaid taxes, which significantly adds to its already substantial government surplus. While seemingly positive, this windfall presents an economic dilemma as Ireland struggles with how to spend the funds and questions its long-standing relationship with U.S. tech giants amidst existing infrastructure and housing crises. The country faces pressure to invest in improvements to maintain its attractiveness as a business hub, despite concerns about overheating the economy or securing funds for future needs.

title: T. Rowe Price Tapping Into Experienced Managers
summary: T. Rowe Price is successfully bringing experienced mutual fund managers into the ETF industry, leveraging their active management skills. The firm has launched several active ETFs, some replicating successful mutual funds and others managed by seasoned teams. This strategy has led to significant asset growth in their ETF offerings, appealing to advisors.

title: Jabil Inc to invest Rs 2,000 crore in Trichy
summary: Jabil Inc, a key supplier to Apple and others, is set to invest Rs 2,000 crore in Trichy, Tamil Nadu. This significant investment is expected to create 5,000 jobs and foster a new electronics manufacturing cluster in the region, as announced by Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M.K. Stalin.

title: BlackRock Inc. Expands Stake in Repay Holdings Corp
summary: BlackRock Inc. significantly increased its stake in Repay Holdings Corp by acquiring an additional 733,419 shares on August 31, 2024, bringing its total holdings to 8,800,357 shares. This investment reflects BlackRock's strategic interest in the digital financial services sector, despite Repay Holdings Corp's current unprofitability and recent stock price decline, suggesting a long-term view on the growing digital payments industry.

title: Tamil Nadu government signs pact with US firms for Rs 2,666 crore, 5,365 jobs
summary: The Tamil Nadu government has signed investment agreements worth over Rs 2,600 crore with US companies, Jabil and Rockwell Automation, during Chief Minister MK Stalin's visit to the United States. These agreements are expected to create 5,365 jobs in the state. Jabil will invest Rs 2,000 crore in a new electronics manufacturing unit in Tiruchirappalli, while Rockwell Automation will expand its Kanchipuram unit with an investment of Rs 666 crore.

title: Jabil Inc to pour Rs 2,000 Crore into new electronics manufacturing plant in Tiruchi
summary: Jabil Inc is committing Rs 2,000 crore to establish a new electronics manufacturing facility in Tiruchi, Tamil Nadu, a strategic investment expected to create approximately 5,000 jobs. This move is part of broader industrial development efforts in the region, with Jabil Inc. and Rockwell Automation collectively investing Rs 2,666 crore. The expansion reinforces Tamil Nadu's growing prominence as an electronics manufacturing hub.

title: Should TCW Transform 500 ETF (VOTE) Be on Your Investing Radar?
summary: The TCW Transform 500 ETF (VOTE) is a passively managed exchange-traded fund launched on June 22, 2021, focusing on the Large Cap Blend segment of the US equity market. With over $682.12 million in assets and an expense ratio of 0.05%, it aims to track the Morningstar US Large Cap Select Index. The ETF has shown strong performance, gaining 17.30% year-to-date and 25.40% over the last year as of September 12, 2024, with significant allocation to the Information Technology sector.

title: Top EU court rules Apple owes Ireland over $14B in back taxes
summary: The European Union Court of Justice has ruled that Apple must pay over 13 billion euros (more than $14 billion) in back taxes to Ireland, concluding a years-long legal battle. This decision overturned a 2020 ruling and supports the European Commission's claim that special tax rates offered to Apple constituted unlawful state aid. The ruling stems from the 2017 Paradise Papers investigation, which revealed how Apple restructured its Irish companies to gain significant tax advantages.

title: ResMed lauds Apple’s sleep apnoea detection feature
summary: ResMed (NYSE:RMD) has expressed strong support for Apple's new sleep apnea detection feature integrated into its latest smartwatches, believing it will significantly increase awareness and early diagnosis of the disorder. ResMed highlights the widespread and often undiagnosed nature of sleep apnea, which affects nearly 2.5 billion people, and sees Apple's involvement as a collaborative step toward improving global health outcomes. Both companies emphasize the critical role of sleep in overall health and the potential of technology to identify serious medical conditions.

title: iOS 18 is available today, making iPhone more personal and capable than ever
summary: Apple has released iOS 18, bringing significant updates to iPhone customization, the Photos app, Messages, Mail, and introducing Apple Intelligence. Users can now personalize their Home Screen and Control Center, enjoy a redesigned Photos experience with automatic organization, and benefit from enhanced communication features. Apple Intelligence, rolling out next month, integrates generative models with personal context for advanced features in writing, photo editing, and Siri, all while prioritizing user privacy.

title: Pacer MSCI World Industry Advantage ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (BATS:GLBL)
summary: The Pacer MSCI World Industry Advantage ETF (GLBL) is an exchange-traded fund that invests in total market equity from leading countries, tracking an index that selects securities with the highest active weight in GICS Industry Groups. The ETF was launched on September 16, 2024, and its stock has seen a 6.8% increase since the beginning of 2026, trading at $26.90. Its top holdings include major tech companies like Amazon.com, NVIDIA, Microsoft, Apple, and Alphabet.

title: Reneo Pharmaceuticals executive buys shares worth over $484k By Investing.com
summary: Braden Michael Leonard, a significant shareholder of Reneo Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:RPHM), recently invested over $484,000 in the company's common stock through a series of purchases. This insider buying activity comes amidst other company developments, including the termination of its Chief Development Officer and an announced merger with OnKure, Inc., which will discontinue Reneo's historical drug development activities. Despite a significant stock decline over the past year, InvestingPro insights highlight aggressive share buybacks by management, a strong cash position, and a potentially undervalued stock based on its P/B ratio.

title: Tata Inks Pact With Analog Devices To Explore Opportunities In Indian Chip Manufacturing
summary: Tata Group has partnered with US-based Analog Devices to build a robust electronics manufacturing ecosystem in India. This collaboration involves Tata Electronics manufacturing Analog Devices' products at its upcoming Gujarat fab plant and Assam OSAT facility, with production expected to start by 2026. Additionally, Tata Motors and Analog Devices will explore joint manufacturing of electronic hardware for electric vehicles and energy solutions.

title: Macquarie Group mulls $2.3b stake sale in UK’s Wavenet: Bloomberg
summary: Macquarie Group is reportedly considering selling its stake in UK information technology services provider Wavenet, a deal that could be valued at £1.2 billion ($2.3 billion). The Australian financial giant is open to divesting a majority stake, with a formal sale process expected to begin next year. Wavenet, which provides cybersecurity and cloud solutions, recently merged with Daisy Corporate Services and serves clients like the NHS Trusts and John Lewis Plc.

title: MUSQ Global Music Industry ETF Celebrates Its One-Year Anniversary on the New York Stock Exchange
summary: MUSQ LLC announced the one-year anniversary of its MUSQ Global Music Industry ETF (NYSE:MUSQ) debut on the New York Stock Exchange. The fund has surpassed $22 million in assets under management (AUM), offering investors diversified exposure to the global music ecosystem. With the global music industry projected to reach $163.7 billion by 2030, the ETF provides access to key players like Spotify, Universal Music Group, Apple, Alphabet, and Sony Group.

title: Apple surpasses forecasts with strong Q3 2024 performance
summary: Apple Inc. reported strong Q3 2024 earnings, surpassing forecasts with $85.8 billion in revenue and an 11% increase in earnings per diluted share. The company's iPhone sales remained robust, contributing significantly to revenue, while Mac and iPad sales also saw growth. Despite varied regional performance and a slight decline in product revenue for the nine months ending June 29, 2024, Apple's focus on innovation, customer loyalty, and sustainability, combined with rising R&D investments and a strong services segment, positions it for continued market leadership.

title: Apple ships $6 billion of iPhones from India in big China shift
summary: Apple's iPhone exports from India increased by a third to nearly $6 billion in the six months ending September, signaling a significant shift from China. This expansion is driven by Indian subsidies and a skilled workforce, with the company on track to surpass $10 billion in annual exports for fiscal year 2024. Despite its growth in India, Apple still relies heavily on China for manufacturing and sales, though its Indian revenue hit a record $8 billion due to new stores and increased demand.

title: The queues for iPhone 16 track emerging economic realities
summary: The article discusses how the queues for the iPhone 16 reflect emerging economic realities, with strong demand and long lines observed in APAC regions like India, Taiwan, Thailand, China, UAE, Australia, and Malaysia, contrasting with a more muted reception in some European countries. It suggests that Apple's strategy to focus on emerging markets is paying off, potentially leading to new sales records that compensate for slower growth in traditional Western markets, and highlighting a shift in global economic dynamism.

title: Politan prevails in Masimo proxy fight, gaining 2 board seats and ousting CEO Joe Kiani
summary: Activist investor Politan Capital Management secured two new board seats at Masimo's annual meeting, leading to the ouster of founder and CEO Joe Kiani and fellow board member Chris Chavez. This victory doubles Politan's previous board representation and follows criticism over Masimo's acquisition of Sound United and its plans to spin out consumer businesses. Following the vote, Masimo's stock price saw a 3.4% increase.

title: Is the iShares Russell 1000 Growth ETF a Millionaire Maker?
summary: This article discusses the iShares Russell 1000 Growth ETF (IWF) as a potential "millionaire maker" investment. It highlights the ETF's historical performance, its focus on growth stocks within the Russell 1000 index, and its exposure to both large and mid-cap companies. The author suggests that while not perfectly balanced, IWF offers a good chance to outperform the broader market over the long term.

title: Should Motley Fool 100 Index ETF (TMFC) Be on Your Investing Radar?
summary: The Motley Fool 100 Index ETF (TMFC) is highlighted as a suitable option for investors seeking exposure to the Large Cap Growth segment of the US equity market, especially given its strong performance and Zacks ETF Rank of 2 (Buy). The article details its expense ratio, sector allocation, top holdings like Apple, Microsoft, and Nvidia, and compares it to alternative ETFs such as Vanguard Growth ETF (VUG) and Invesco QQQ (QQQ). Investors are encouraged to consider TMFC's attributes alongside its risk and performance metrics for long-term investment strategies.

title: Capturing the in vogue ‘mega-forces’ in a one-stop ETF shop
summary: The iShares Global 100 ETF (IOO) was recognized as the top ETF Product at the 2024 Financial Newswire/SQM Research Fund Manager of the Year Awards. This BlackRock fund specifically targets top-performing global companies, focusing on those with diversified revenue streams and large market caps, moving beyond simple index tracking. It has a strong track record of capitalizing on prevailing mega-trends like technology and AI, demonstrating consistent performance in capturing global economic transformers.

title: Amkor Falls 18% in 3 Months: How Should Investors Play the Stock?
summary: Amkor Technology (AMKR) shares have declined by 17.7% in the last three months due to supply chain disruptions, macroeconomic challenges, and semiconductor shortages. The company faces stiff competition in the OSAT market from Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSM) and ASE Technology Holding (ASX) and is currently rated a Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell). Investors are advised to sell the stock given these headwinds, despite its partnerships with major tech giants like Apple.

title: Artificial Intelligence and Adaptive Portfolio Management
summary: This article highlights a podcast episode from Investor Insights that explores the role of Artificial Intelligence in adaptive portfolio management. The discussion emphasizes AI as a tool to enhance human expertise in creating sophisticated investment applications and evolving portfolio strategies from traditional "buy and hold" approaches. It concludes that investors need to understand AI's implications for portfolio management, even if they don't grasp its technical intricacies.

title: Hello Group: Undervalued With Expertise In App Development Makes It Attractive
summary: Hello Group (MOMO) is considered significantly undervalued with a P/E ratio of 5x TTM Non-GAAP earnings and 2x TTM EBITDA, presenting a strong buy opportunity. The company benefits from its app development expertise, presence in China's market, and a recently upsized stock repurchase program. However, risks include its Cayman Islands incorporation, operational challenges in China, and potential regulatory changes.

title: Apple unexpectedly fell on rebalancing day, who is the culprit?
summary: Apple experienced a surprising downturn on a rebalancing day when it was expected to benefit from index adjustments. Despite anticipation of increased buying pressure from index funds, a massive sell-off of 30 million shares occurred in the final minutes of trading. Theories suggest either active funds capitalizing on predictable liquidity or arbitrageurs selling after accumulating shares before the rebalancing event contributed to the unexpected drop.

title: Spotify expands AI Playlist feature to four new markets, including U.S. and Canada
summary: Spotify is expanding its AI Playlist feature for premium users to four new markets, including the United States and Canada. This tool, currently in beta, allows subscribers to create personalized song selections using generative AI and text prompts. The expansion aims to attract new subscribers and enhance the app's features amidst competition from Apple and Amazon.

title: The Marygold Companies Secures Private Placement to Finance Next-Stage Rollout Initiatives for Recently Developed Fintech Product
summary: The Marygold Companies, Inc. secured $4.38 million in funding, part of a $6.56 million private placement with Streeterville Capital, LLC, to finance the rollout of its Marygold & Co. fintech app. This digital banking alternative, already soft-launched in the U.S., is set for further market penetration including in the U.K. later this year, leveraging recently acquired investment advisory firms. The app offers features like a digital wallet, physical debit card, and tools for saving and investing, aiming to provide a private banking experience without traditional fees.

title: SWP Growth & Income ETF Holdings
summary: The SWP Growth & Income ETF, established on September 25, 2024, focuses on income-producing, quality U.S. companies primarily in the large-cap sector. It manages $150.5 million in assets across 48 holdings. The ETF's top holdings include major tech companies like Microsoft, Broadcom, and Apple, alongside other diversified businesses.

title: Broadcom: Semiconductors, M&A's, and Bold Leadership
summary: This article details Broadcom's journey from its origins in HP's division and Broadcom Corporation to becoming a global semiconductor giant through strategic mergers and acquisitions. It highlights CEO Hock Tan's leadership in expanding the company's product portfolio across semiconductors, software, and infrastructure solutions. The company's strategy involves targeting niche markets and utilizing a fabless design model to achieve market dominance.

title: The Suppliers Behind the Apple Pencil Pro
summary: The Apple Pencil Pro, launched in May 2024, relies heavily on a global network of key third-party suppliers for its advanced components, demonstrating Apple's strategic use of outsourcing. Companies like TSMC, Texas Instruments, Bosch, and SiTime provide essential chips, sensors, and timing solutions, enabling Apple to focus on design and user experience. This collaborative approach highlights Apple's competitive advantage in leveraging specialized expertise, rather than attempting to produce all components in-house.

title: Apple’s Lisa Jackson on How to Design for Sustainability
summary: Lisa Jackson, Apple's VP of environment, policy, and social initiatives, advises entrepreneurs on designing for sustainability by involving affected communities and embracing regulation. Drawing from her EPA experience, she highlights how regulation "levels the playing field" for businesses committed to environmental responsibility and encourages young people to pursue careers in sustainability, stressing the importance of scientific understanding.

title: InterDigital, IBD Stock Of The Day, Flirts With Buy Point After Analyst Day
summary: InterDigital (IDCC) has been named IBD Stock Of The Day and is approaching a buy point of 140.60 after an analyst day. The stock has a Composite Rating of 95/99 and is forming a shallow flat base. The article also mentions widespread investment in AI stocks by major tech companies.

title: 'Coin-sized' version of Dexcom G6 sensor developed in China
summary: Researchers from Chinese universities have developed a miniature continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) system that is as effective as market-leading devices like the Dexcom G6. This coin-sized biosensor utilizes an organic electrochemical transistor (OECT) for improved signal-to-noise ratio and stability, making it suitable for wearable applications. The team is now moving towards clinical application of their innovative CGM system.

title: Guo Mingxi: Meta AR glasses Orion will be mass-produced as early as 2027, positioning to replace mobile phones and computers.
summary: Analyst Ming-Chi Kuo from TF International Securities predicts that Meta's AR glasses, Orion, could enter mass production as early as 2027, aiming to replace smartphones and tablets. Orion's key selling points are its integration of AI technology and spatial computing, though technical challenges and production partner decisions could delay the timeline. Meta may release a lower-spec version before the full-scale mass production to gather market feedback.

title: Ingram Micro IPO, Revenue Details Go Live
summary: Ingram Micro has filed its registration statement with the SEC for a proposed initial public offering, with its common stock set to trade under the symbol "INGM" on the New York Stock Exchange. The filing reveals that Ingram Micro's net sales have declined over the past three years, from $54.4 billion in 2021 to $48 billion in 2023. Platinum Equity, which owns Ingram, will sell the common stock through its entity Imola JV Holdings, with the number of available shares and price range yet to be determined.

title: Goldman Sachs Reiterates Buy Rating on Jabil (JBL)
summary: Goldman Sachs has reiterated a Buy rating on Jabil (NYSE: JBL) with a $136.00 price target, following the company's Q4 FY24 earnings report. Despite a mixed report with FY25 EBIT guidance modestly below the Street, Goldman Sachs believes Jabil's repositioned business mix, focusing on favorable end markets like datacenter, auto, industrial, renewables, and medical, will drive long-term growth. The firm also notes Jabil's investments in these areas, addition of new hyperscale customers, and supportive capital allocation as reasons to maintain a positive outlook.

title: ResMed Unveils New Collection of Digital and Personalized Solutions designed to Improve Sleep Health
summary: ResMed has announced new patient-centric products aimed at enhancing the therapy journey for sleep apnea patients, integrating with digital wearables and generative AI for a more personalized sleep health experience. Key innovations include a myAir™ smartwatch app, sleep staging integration, personalized coaching, holistic health trend tracking, and an AI-enabled sleep health concierge named Dawn. Additionally, ResMed introduced LUXE travel gear designed for CPAP users on the go.

title: Xiao-I Awaits Final Ruling On Patent Infringement Lawsuit Against Apple Over AI Technology Claims
summary: Xiao-I Corp. (AIXI) is awaiting a final ruling in its patent infringement lawsuit against Apple Computer Trading (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. and Apple, Inc. (AAPL) concerning alleged infringements on AI technology. The Shanghai High People's Court held a hearing on September 24, 2024, and the trial concluded on July 31, 2024. Both parties are now awaiting the Court's decision.

title: Apple launches new professional learning resources for teachers and expands global education grant program
summary: Apple has launched new free classroom resources for teachers and students to encourage creativity, coinciding with World Teachers' Day. The company also announced a significant expansion of its education grant program to include 100 new schools across six continents, providing free grant-funded STEAM programming. Additionally, Apple released its first-ever Education Impact Report, detailing its global efforts to support educators and learners.

title: Coherent sells wafer fab to UK's Ministry of Defence for reported £20M
summary: Coherent has sold its gallium arsenide (GaAs) wafer fabrication facility in the north of England to the UK government for a reported £20 million. The move is part of Coherent's strategy to optimize its portfolio and streamline operations following the 2022 merger of II-VI and the original Coherent laser business. While the UK's Ministry of Defence acquired the fab, a new company, Octric Semiconductors, managed by the former general manager of the facility, has been formed, with the MoD emphasizing a focus on military applications for the secure GaAs fab.

title: Threat assessment: ranking risk among US companies dealing with China
summary: A market research firm, Strategy Risks, has identified the most vulnerable US companies among the top 250 publicly listed firms regarding their exposure to China. Ford Motor, Carrier, Tesla, Apple, and Coca-Cola were ranked highest due to their extensive business ties to the country. The assessment considered factors like supply chain dynamics, government connections, and industry regulations in China.

title: Invesco QQQ Stock Forecast Monthly 2024, 2025 To 2030
summary: This article provides a long-term forecast for Invesco QQQ stock from 2024 to 2030, based on its past performance and future business strategies, particularly focusing on the growth of its underlying tech giant holdings. It details monthly forecasts for 2024 and segmented forecasts for subsequent years, alongside QQQ's fundamentals, historical price data, and its top 20 holdings on the Nasdaq-100 Index. The analysis suggests QQQ could be a good long-term investment given its strong portfolio of tech companies.

title: Germany hit with another OnePlus sales ban after new 5G patent dispute ahead of OnePlus 13 launch
summary: OnePlus is facing another sales ban in Germany due to a new 5G patent dispute with InterDigital, similar to a prior one with Nokia. This new dispute has halted smartphone sales in the German online store shortly before the anticipated launch of the OnePlus 13. The company is in negotiations with InterDigital to resolve the issue quickly, as the previous dispute took two years to settle.

title: Cap-weighted vs. equal-weighted ETFs: Which is best for Canadian investors?
summary: This article explores the pros and cons of cap-weighted versus equal-weighted ETFs for Canadian investors, especially in light of the concentrated dominance of "Magnificent 7" tech stocks. It delves into the potential concentration risk of cap-weighted indexes and examines whether equal weighting offers a better solution, ultimately concluding that cap-weighting, due to its simplicity and lower friction costs, tends to be more effective for long-term risk-adjusted returns despite some arguments for equal weighting's diversification benefits.

title: Visa monopolizes debit card networks, DOJ lawsuit claims
summary: The U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) has filed an antitrust lawsuit against Visa Inc., alleging the company maintains an unlawful monopoly on debit card networks. The lawsuit claims Visa engages in anticompetitive practices, such as penalizing banks and merchants using alternative payment systems and making agreements with technology companies like Apple, PayPal, and Square to prevent them from becoming competitors. These actions have allowed Visa to control over 60% of debit card transactions and charge more than $7 billion in processing fees, which the DOJ argues are passed on to consumers.

title: Run the Neighborhood: NBA® 2K25 Arcade Edition Now Available on Apple Arcade
summary: 2K has announced the release of NBA® 2K25 Arcade Edition on Apple Arcade, featuring NBA champion Jayson Tatum on the cover. This latest installment brings new features like an expanded MyCAREER mode with an interactive Neighborhood, a GOAT Challenge to relive NBA legends' careers starting with Jayson Tatum, and an improved tutorial system through Quests. Upcoming Seasons will offer fresh rewards and updates for players across Apple devices including iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, and Apple Vision Pro.

title: TSMC signs deal with US chip test firm
summary: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co (TSMC) has partnered with Amkor Technology Inc to provide advanced packaging and test services in Arizona, supporting customer needs for geographical flexibility in chip manufacturing. This collaboration will establish local advanced packaging capabilities for TSMC's customers, especially those using its Phoenix, Arizona wafer fabrication facilities, and aims to strengthen the US semiconductor ecosystem. Amkor's planned facility in Peoria, Arizona, will be the largest outsourced advanced packaging and test facility in the US, with TSMC leveraging its services for technologies like Integrated Fan-Out (InFO) and Chip on Wafer on Substrate (CoWoS).

title: How BP Hopes to Boost User Touch Points With Its New Loyalty App
summary: BP has launched a new loyalty app called "earnify" to increase customer engagement and drive its mobility business in the U.S. The app allows users to earn points on fuel and in-store purchases, offering rewards and a 5-cents-per-gallon discount on gas. BP expects "earnify" to significantly boost daily customer touchpoints globally.

title: Top Stock Movers Now: Humana, Amazon, Apple, and More
summary: U.S. equities saw declines at midday due to rising oil futures and bond yields. Humana, Apple, and Amazon shares fell after analyst downgrades, while Super Micro Computer stock jumped following a major GPU delivery to AI factories. Pfizer and Arcadium Lithium also saw gains on positive news regarding investments and potential acquisition.

title: Apple Dips as Jefferies Says Hopes for AI Phone Are Overblown
summary: Apple Inc. shares fell after a Jefferies analyst, Edison Lee, stated that investor expectations for the AI-powered iPhone 16/17 are "premature" and "overblown." Jefferies downgraded its rating on Apple stock to "hold," citing a lack of material new features and limited AI coverage that suggests high market expectations for unit growth will not be met.

title: Florence manufacturing plant closes, resulting in layoffs for 108 workers
summary: Multinational manufacturing company Jabil is closing one of its facilities on Ted Bushelman Drive in Florence, Kentucky, resulting in the layoff of 108 plant workers. The closure is due to one of Jabil's customers moving out of state, and the layoffs are projected to be completed by December 6. Jabil, a Fortune 150 company headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, manufactures electronic circuit boards and systems for major companies including Apple, Coca-Cola, and Alphabet.

title: Here’s why I’d avoid the DGRO ETF and buy VOO instead
summary: The article advises investors to prefer the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO) over the iShares Core Dividend Growth ETF (DGRO) for long-term investments. Although DGRO has performed well, VOO has demonstrated superior returns and a lower expense ratio. The author argues that DGRO's low dividend yield makes it less attractive compared to government bonds or other dividend-focused ETFs.

title: 3 Powerful ETFs for Income Seekers Looking to Maximize Gains
summary: This article highlights three ETFs, VOO, XLE, and PEY, that offer income-seeking investors a combination of long-term growth and dividend income. VOO provides broad market exposure with a low expense ratio, XLE offers exposure to the energy sector with a strong dividend yield and potential upside from geopolitical tensions, and PEY focuses on high-dividend-paying stocks with potential for capital appreciation. Each ETF is presented as a suitable option for conservative, buy-and-hold investors looking for stability and income.

title: How Masimo’s 20-year CEO was ousted by activist investors
summary: This article details how activist investor firm Politan Capital successfully ousted Masimo’s long-standing CEO and founder, Joe Kiani, after a two-year battle. The conflict arose from Masimo's controversial acquisition of Sound United, which led to a significant drop in stock value and concerns from investors. Ultimately, Politan Capital gained majority control of the company's board, leading to Kiani's resignation.

title: Amazon Adds Apple TV+ to Its Channels Store for Streaming
summary: Amazon.com Inc. is integrating Apple Inc.'s TV+ streaming service into its US channels store, making popular shows like "Ted Lasso" available through Prime. This collaboration will allow Apple to sell TV+ subscriptions directly through Amazon Prime, starting later this month. The announcement was made by Mike Hopkins, senior vice president of Amazon Prime Video, at a Bloomberg conference.

title: Unafraid of Wall Street's pessimism! Apple's stock price approaching a new high, has it shaken off the shadow of the "Stock God"'s shareholding?
summary: Despite Wall Street's pessimism, Apple's stock price is nearing a new high, seemingly unaffected by Buffett's recent shareholding reduction. The iPhone 16 series, particularly the Pro models, are performing better than expected, although material costs have increased. Analysts remain cautious about short-term sales growth due to limited AI innovation and high valuation.

title: Living Without Apple CarPlay in the Chevrolet Equinox EV
summary: The Chevrolet Equinox EV will not offer Apple CarPlay or Android Auto, instead relying on its Google Built-In infotainment system. While the built-in Google Maps offers superior EV-specific routing, the overall user experience, including music apps and text message access, is less intuitive than Apple CarPlay and requires a data subscription. The author questions Chevrolet's decision to omit a popular feature when competitors offer both native and smartphone mirroring systems.

title: Texas Instruments: From Calculators to Master Capital Allocators
summary: Texas Instruments (TI), founded in 1930 as an oil exploration business, evolved into a leading global semiconductor company. The article traces TI's history from its military contributions and invention of the integrated circuit to its near-monopoly in calculators and its current focus on analog and embedded processors. TI is highlighted as a master capital allocator, emphasizing long-term shareholder value through disciplined investments, dividends, and share repurchases, especially during economic downturns.

title: Wearable Devices Announces the Launch of Mudra Band for Apple Watch on Walmart.com, Expanding Access to Its Innovative Gesture-Controlled Wearable Technology
summary: Wearable Devices Ltd. launched its Mudra Band for Apple Watch on Walmart.com, significantly expanding its market reach in the U.S. This move follows a successful introduction on Amazon, making the AI-powered neural-based gesture control technology more accessible to Apple users nationwide. The Mudra Band allows hands-free interaction with Apple devices using simple neural gestures.

title: US labor board accuses Apple of restricting workers' Slack, social media use
summary: The U.S. National Labor Relations Board has accused Apple of interfering with workers' rights by restricting their use of social media and Slack, and illegally firing an employee for advocating for workplace changes. This marks the second complaint against Apple this month from the NLRB. Apple denies the claims, stating its commitment to a positive workplace and vowing to present facts at a hearing.

title: Should You Buy Class A Shares of Berkshire Hathaway Below $700,000?
summary: This article examines the investment potential of Berkshire Hathaway's Class A shares, particularly when trading below $700,000. It discusses Berkshire's valuation methods, including price-to-tangible book value and price-to-earnings ratios, and highlights the company's strong business moat, significant cash reserves, and exceptional track record. Despite leadership changes, the article concludes that Class A shares remain a solid long-term investment.

title: Jabil opens 516,000 sqft manufacturing site in Croatia
summary: Jabil, a US electronic components maker, has opened a 516,000 square feet manufacturing site in Osijek, Croatia, its first greenfield investment in Europe in 20 years. The facility aims to support customers in the automotive, transportation, and healthcare industries, leveraging Osijek's strategic location and a highly skilled workforce. Jabil also provided financial forecasts for fiscal year 2025, anticipating $27 billion in revenue and restructuring costs between $150 million and $200 million.

title: Freedom Holding Corp. celebrates five years on Nasdaq, marking Cyprus’ strategic role
summary: Freedom Holding Corp., parent company of Freedom24, celebrates five years on Nasdaq, highlighting its commitment to transparency and growth. Executive Director Evgenii Tiapkin discusses the challenges and rewards of the Nasdaq listing, the company's significant growth in client numbers, and Cyprus' strategic role as its headquarters. Freedom24 aims to expand its services beyond brokerage to banking with an anticipated EMI license and plans for a "super app," while emphasizing its regulatory compliance and contributions to the Cypriot economy.

title: Destiny: Rising announced, a free-to-play mobile shooter developed by NetEase
summary: NetEase Games has announced Destiny: Rising, a free-to-play mobile shooter set in an alternate timeline within the Destiny universe. Officially licensed by Bungie, the game will feature hero shooter elements, campaign missions, six-player strikes, and both PVE and PVP modes.
